offices.name: Office of the Mayor
offices.head: Ahmedin Ismail, Mayor
offices.does: Leads the city administration, chairs the cabinet, and owns this portal.

offices.name: City Council
offices.head: Speaker to be confirmed
offices.does: Approves the city budget, plans and local rules. Meetings are public.

offices.name: Municipality (City Manager)
offices.head: To be confirmed
offices.does: Runs municipal services: sanitation, waste, signs and advertising, abattoir, city property and street lighting.

offices.name: Land Development and Management Office
offices.head: To be confirmed
offices.does: Land lease, land-use rent, site plans, title transfer and the land register.

offices.name: Urban Development and Construction Office
offices.head: To be confirmed
offices.does: Building permits, inspections, roads, drainage and the corridor development projects.

offices.name: Finance Office
offices.head: To be confirmed
offices.does: City budget, payments, receipts, procurement and tenders.

offices.name: Revenue Office
offices.head: To be confirmed
offices.does: Taxes and municipal service charges, tax clearance certificates.

offices.name: Trade and Market Development Office
offices.head: To be confirmed
offices.does: Trade licences, market stalls, consumer protection and fair prices.

offices.name: Investment and Industry Office
offices.head: To be confirmed
offices.does: Investment land, investor support and industry development.

offices.name: Culture and Tourism Office
offices.head: Kamaal Badhaasoo
offices.does: Lake and island tourism, boat associations, festivals such as Timket and Irreecha, and heritage sites such as Ardaa Jilaa Qixxee Waayyuu.

offices.name: Youth and Sports Office
offices.head: To be confirmed
offices.does: Sports fields, youth centres and venue bookings.

offices.name: Civil Registration (Vital Events) Office
offices.head: To be confirmed
offices.does: Birth, marriage, divorce and death registration and certificates.

offices.name: Public Service and Human Resource Development Office
offices.head: Jeylaan Burqaa
offices.does: City jobs and vacancies, service standards, staff conduct and complaints about service.

offices.name: Government Communication Office
offices.head: To be confirmed
offices.does: News, notices, media requests and the city's social media.

offices.name: Education Office
offices.head: To be confirmed
offices.does: Public kindergartens, primary and secondary schools, enrolment and exams.

offices.name: Health Office
offices.head: To be confirmed
offices.does: Batu Hospital and health centres, vaccination, maternal health and community health insurance.

offices.name: Batu Water Supply and Sewerage Service
offices.head: To be confirmed
offices.does: Drinking water treated from Lake Dambal, new connections, water bills and leaks.

offices.name: Agriculture and Environmental Protection Office
offices.head: To be confirmed
offices.does: Urban agriculture, greening, lake shore protection and fisheries support.

offices.name: Job Creation and Skills Office
offices.head: To be confirmed
offices.does: Support for micro and small enterprises, youth jobs and work spaces.

offices.name: Women, Children and Social Affairs Office
offices.head: To be confirmed
offices.does: Support for women, children, older people and people with disabilities.

offices.name: Peace and Security Office
offices.head: To be confirmed
offices.does: Community safety, event permits and coordination with the police.

offices.name: Batu City Police
offices.head: To be confirmed
offices.does: Policing and crime reports. In an emergency call 991.

offices.name: Justice Office (Public Prosecutor)
offices.head: To be confirmed
offices.does: Public prosecution and legal awareness.

offices.name: Kebele administrations
offices.head: See Find my kebele
offices.does: Resident IDs, residence letters and local services close to home.
